name: user_liaison
description: Align user intent and agent understanding; guide human attention, convey decisions and remain available for conversation.

name: project_lead
description: Own project-wide execution and acceptance; coordinate EL responsibilities when an approved multi-EL expansion needs a separate PL.

name: execution_lead
description: Turn agreed direction into area execution, actively coordinate it, and own the coherence and authorized integration of assigned results.

name: area_coordinator
description: Own an approved area: define TC deliverables, coordinate their progress and curate coherent area results.

name: task_coordinator
description: Own one bounded deliverable: coordinate workers, independent review, correction and task integration.

name: workflow_worker
description: Implement and verify a bounded contribution, resolve review findings directly and return a usable result to TC.

name: integration_reviewer
description: Independently assess combined work and acceptance gaps, reusing valid prior reviews; review only, do not implement fixes.

name: project_execution_lead
description: Hold executive PL and EL responsibilities together for the initial single-EL project; UL remains separate.

name: area_task_coordinator
description: Hold AC and TC responsibilities together for an area served by one bounded deliverable.
